label: failure_to_yield
title: A rider counted as a pedestrian
note: The 'pedestrian' on the far-right crossing is a person on a small scooter that YOLO did not detect, so the rider filter (person box overlapping a bicycle/motorcycle box) could not remove it.

label: red_light
title: Creeping over the line just before green
note: The car crosses the stop line about 1 s before the signal turns green. The rule requires the light to still be red 1 s after the crossing, which removes these borderline cases; annotators may count it as red-light running.

label: jaywalking
title: Six pedestrians merged into one 39 s segment
note: Each person really crosses the intersection diagonally, but same-class segments must not overlap, so back-to-back crossings merge into one long segment (79-118 s). If the annotators split them differently, temporal IoU can fall below 0.5.

label: jaywalking
title: Detouring around cars that block the crossing
note: Cars have stopped on the far-road zebra, so a group of pedestrians walks around them 2-4 m beside the markings. The rule counts this as jaywalking; annotators may not.

label: stop_line
title: Vehicles blocking the far-road crossing are not detected
note: Only the queue approach has a stop line and a visible signal head. For the far-road approach the signal faces away from the camera, so vehicles stopped on that zebra (the same frame) are not flagged by any rule.

label: jaywalking
title: Short-cut from the main zebra to the island
note: Pedestrians leave the main zebra and cut across the corner to the refuge island. The ~1 m tolerance around zebras, added to stop kerb-side false alarms, also hides this short-cut.
